experiments.title: A venue's total stops adding up
experiments.plain: In Eastmere venue HV-EM01's quarter-3 file, the attendance total is changed to 1400 while its parts still add up to 1309.
experiments.predict: The venue's file arrived on time. Does the quarter get approved anyway?
experiments.look_for: totals_reconcile now names HV-EM01 (1400 reported, parts add up to 1309). Approval stays blocked even after the late and corrected files arrive, and nothing is published for the quarter.
